Talent0_2Ability.name: Ammo Upgrade
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: After sortie, gain <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=4003503>[SP Ammo I]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks. After an Active Attack with a Rail Gun, remove <color=#F74848>1</color> stack.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Ammo Upgrade
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
After sortie, gain <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=4003503>[SP Ammo I]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks. After an Active Attack with a Rail Gun, remove <color=#F74848>1</color> stack.
Whenever [Your Turn] starts, gain <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=4003503>[SP Ammo I]</buf>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

700053.name: Overflow Scatter
700053.describe: Uses Shotgun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.15x</color> DMG. Before combat, gains <buf ID=7100501>[Crit DMG UP I]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

700048.name: Sabotage
700048.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, deals an additional <color=#F74848>20%</color> DMG to the part with HP below <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

700030.name: Dash
700030.describe: Gain <buf ID=7100901>[Movement UP]</buf> and <buf ID=7100403>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue the action with the remaining movement.

400305.name: Power Optimization
400305.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, if critical hits are landed, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400306.name: Repair Disabled Rail Gun
400306.describe: Uses Rail Gun to attack all targets within a <range type=1>Line (1*5 tiles) area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.0x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, it inflicts <buf ID=4003063>[Repair Hindrance]</buf> on affected targets, lasting <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

400307.name: Interferents
400307.SpecificEffects: If a part is broken during an attack, the target will lose <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat.

400308.name: The Group's Gift
400308.describe: Uses Rail Gun to attack all targets within a <range type=1>Line (1*5 tiles) area</range>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.1x</color> AoE DMG. After combat, transforms tiles hit into <buf ID=4003081>[Burning Terrain]</buf>, lasting <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

400341.name: Middle Management 1
400341.SpecificEffects: After sortie, gain <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks of <buf ID=900054>[SP Ammo]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>3</color> stacks.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400344.name: Middle Management 2
400344.SpecificEffects: The <buf ID=900054>[SP Ammo]</buf> effect provides additional Range <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

400345.name: Middle Management 3
400345.SpecificEffects: The <buf ID=900054>[SP Ammo]</buf> effect grants Crit DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

400346.name: Middle Management 4
400346.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Rail Gun, if a part is broken, deal <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> once for <color=#F74848>0.35x</color> DMG to enemies within a <color=#F74848>1</color>-tile range around the target after combat.
